title: A painless punch with a microneedle patch could detect kidney disease earlier
summary_en: New research from the lab of WashU McKelvey Engineering’s Srikanth Singamaneni shows the early success of a microneedle patch that can be applied on the skin to capture biomarkers of kidney injury. It may one day support home or point-of-care monitoring.
title_cn: A painless punch with a microneedle patch could detect kidney disease earlier

title: FDA clears blood test to aid evaluation for Alzheimer’s disease
summary_en: The biomarker test, called PrecivityAD2, was developed from technology invented at WashU Medicine by Randall J. Bateman, MD, and David M. Holtzman, MD.
title_cn: FDA clears blood test to aid evaluation for Alzheimer’s disease
